subject.title: fix(subagent): recover terminal transcript before lost context

question: Should OpenClaw accept this PR's current-run private transcript stop/end_turn predicate as the lifecycle recovery boundary for the lost-context subagent bug?
rationale: The patch can intentionally turn a stale child run from failed to successful, so green tests do not decide the product/session-state boundary by themselves.

options.title: Proceed with private transcript boundary
options.body: Accept the bounded lifecycle risk after refresh and exact-head validation because this matches the maintainer-stated current-run transcript/status direction.

options.title: Require live Gateway race proof
options.body: Ask for live Agent Teams or Gateway evidence of the context-loss window before accepting the lifecycle-state change.

options.title: Keep error-only fallback
options.body: Pause or close this direction if maintainers decide lost-context recovery must never infer success from private transcript terminal text.

recommendation.title: Proceed with private transcript boundary
recommendation.body: Accept the bounded lifecycle risk after refresh and exact-head validation because this matches the maintainer-stated current-run transcript/status direction.
